messages:
erin: Heads-up — spotted a 404 in the runbook step for Dedicated setup (section about NFS mount). Broken anchor "#dedicated-nfs-mount" from the curl example. Anyone owns that page?
jacob: I think that's under infra runbook ownership, not docs team. Which file path?
maya: If we have the file path I can open a tiny PR to fix the anchor + update the curl snippet.
erin: file is at docs/runbooks/dedicated-deploy.md, around the "Storage & mounts" heading. The curl example links to an internal shortlink that resolves to a fragment that no longer exists.
devon: ah yeah, looks like we renamed the heading to "NFS mounts (deprecated)" last month so the anchor changed. Quick fix is either restore the previous heading or point the link to the new slug. sed to patch locally:
```
# in repo root
sed -n '1,260p' docs/runbooks/dedicated-deploy.md | nl -ba | sed -n '180,220p'
# then in a branch:
rg "shortlink.example.com/s/dedicated#" -n || true
git checkout -b fix/runbook-nfs-anchor
# replace href target
python -c "import io,sys; s=sys.stdin.read(); print(s.replace('#dedicated-nfs-mount','#nfs-mounts-deprecated'))" < docs/runbooks/dedicated-deploy.md > tmp && mv tmp docs/runbooks/dedicated-deploy.md
```
maya: I'll do the branch and PR. Want to update the curl example too to remove the shortlink and use the canonical path. Anyone object to that change?
docs-bot: docs-lint:warning — link-check found 1 broken fragment in docs/runbooks/dedicated-deploy.md: line ~189.
nora: No objections. Quick note: if you change heading text we should add a 301 shortlink redirect or a comment so other refs don't break. Can you add a shortlink mapping in doclinks.yaml?
maya: Good call — adding doclinks.yaml entry in the PR. I'll include the redirect and a tiny changelog entry. PR will be small.
erin: Can you tag jacob for review? He touched this area recently.
maya: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1142 — changed heading back to a clearer "NFS mounts" label, fixed the curl sample to point to /docs/runbooks/dedicated-deploy.md#nfs-mounts and added doclinks.yaml redirect.
jacob: Quick skimed — looks clean, test suite for docs passes locally (link-check ok). I'll give a proper review in a bit.
jacob: LGTM for the content, please squash the fixup commit. :+1:
nora: small nit — add a one-line note in the changelog about the shortlink mapping.
maya: done, added changelog line. Squashed.
jacob: Approved.
erin: Thanks all! I'll flip the staging preview once it lands. :tada:
